classification: PARTIAL ROUTE SUPPORT — TARGETED EVIDENCE STILL REQUIRED

assessment.evidence: MBON-alpha1/MBON07 class and starting root identified; no recording-to-specific-root identity.
SMP353 hemibrain body424443911 and FAFB type match; CB3112/SMP354 annotation alias supported. Actual responders and recall cells not assigned to these roots.
11 starting contacts; candidate convergence/recurrence counted in pinned graph. Counts do not establish efficacy.
Inhibitory Vm response in4/17 broad-driver cells. No responder-to-SMP353/SMP354/root or target receptor crosswalk.
Baseline-subtracted UpWiN somatic mV measured; calcium separate. No gain, latency, current or model-rate conversion identified.
Reciprocal UpWiN mV change acquired; separate alpha1 spike suppression acquired. DAN-driver/dilution/recording differences prevent causal numerical composition.
Wind-relative turn, speed and displacement measured in intact flies; no behavior from a specific root or Vm mapping.
Driver activation and TNT/Shi experiments exist. Root specificity and preserved upstream learning/sensory function for the complete route not shown; restrictive-temperature upwind control fails.
No source-root-to-recorded-target-to-behavior preparation chain; physiological source papers differ in units and conditions.

assessment.requirement: sufficient raw data for prospective thresholds and held-out validation
assessment.evidence: Scalar recall values and cell-mean Vm traces available; Ca/recall mean waveforms lack animal traces, Fig4 animal labels inconsistent, full trajectories unavailable. Do not define thresholds or splits here.

required_evidence: Responding/recall cell morphology or transcript/driver crosswalk to identified SMP353/CB3112-SMP354 homologs
Target-scoped sign/receptor and electrical transmission under compatible preparation, including nonresponders
Original trial/animal identities, event/baseline metadata, ROI masks and exclusion lineage; resolve workbook labels/sample counts
Compatible source/downstream learning measurements isolating alpha1 contribution from beta1 and background routes
Route-specific intervention evidence preserving relevant upstream learning, sensory and locomotor responses; independent neural/action observation relationship
forbidden_inferences: behavioral driver activation = root-specific voluntary choice
